---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose a change to the SDK, Studio or platform runtime.

## Use case

What are you trying to build, and where does the current behavior fall short?

## Expected behavior

Describe the smallest change that would support the use case. Include a short Java, YAML or API example if it helps.

## Compatibility

Note any expected effect on published definitions, existing SDK clients, tenant boundaries or running workflows.
